title: Atomic JSON Write
description: Serialize and write JSON to disk with temp file, fsync, and rename to ensure a reader never sees a partial file.
signature: pub fn write_json_atomic<T: Serialize>(path: &Path, value: &T) -> Result<(), AtomicWriteError>
semantics: Writes JSON atomically by creating a temporary file in the same directory, syncing it to the device, then renaming over the target to ensure a crashed or interrupted process cannot leave a partial file.
